recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間的造血組織被粉紅色纖維束呈漩渦、流線狀取代，細胞排列成條索，並散布許多褐色含鐵血黃素巨噬細胞，脂肪幾乎消失。
features: Intertrabecular marrow replaced by swirling, streaming eosinophilic fibrous bands
Residual hematopoietic and inflammatory cells arranged in cords between fibers
Bony trabeculae at upper and lower right; small vessels within the stroma
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows the intertrabecular space extensively replaced by fibrous stroma arranged in swirling and streaming fascicles. Residual hematopoietic and inflammatory cells are compressed into cords between the fiber bundles, fat spaces are markedly reduced, and numerous brown pigment-laden macrophages consistent with hemosiderin are scattered throughout. Megakaryocytic atypia is not appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow fibrosis; reticulin and trichrome grading, iron stain and clinicopathologic correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: PMF shows atypical megakaryocyte clusters, intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis and osteosclerosis with a driver mutation, not evident at this power.
Carcinoma shows cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests within the desmoplastic stroma.
Mastocytosis produces discrete fibrotic aggregates of spindled CD117/tryptase/CD25-positive mast cells often with eosinophils.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows a polymorphous background with scattered large CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells within the fibrosis.
